summary: BeamNG GmbH's soft-body vehicle physics sandbox, known for realistic deformation, damage, driving scenarios, mod support, and simulation/research spin-off use through BeamNG.tech.

entries.title: BeamNG.drive
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows Steam Early Access build

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows for full support and mod access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows PC build with highest stable settings and mods

primary.why: BeamNG.drive is a Windows-first soft-body vehicle simulation that entered Steam Early Access in 2015, with experimental native Linux support added later. Windows is the primary and most complete route for modding, scenarios, and the current official build.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows Steam Early Access build with desired mods/scenarios; use Linux only if the current experimental support is adequate for your setup.

all_releases.fidelity: Primary Early Access PC build with full soft-body simulation, scenarios, and mod ecosystem.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete and best-supported route.

all_releases.fidelity: Experimental native Linux support added after the Windows Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: skip: experimental alternate route and no sourced content advantage over Windows.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows is both the best-supported and most complete route; Linux is an experimental alternate platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game remains an evolving Early Access-style simulation; revisit version-specific recommendations as major updates land.
